channel.title: Beginner Strength
channel.description: Starting strength training safely, one week at a time.

item.title: What Counts as Strength Training? Bodyweight, Bands, and Daily Lifts
item.description: What federal guidelines count as muscle-strengthening activity, from push-ups and bands to carrying groceries, and what does not count, like stretching.

item.title: Delayed Onset Muscle Soreness, What's Normal for Beginners
item.description: What peer-reviewed exercise science says about the timing and causes of delayed onset muscle soreness, and when soreness stops being a normal response.

item.title: How Often Should Beginners Do Strength Training
item.description: What CDC and WHO physical activity guidelines actually recommend for muscle-strengthening frequency, and how to apply that as a true beginner.

item.title: How to Tell If Your Workout Intensity Is Right
item.description: How to use the talk test, a 0 to 10 effort scale, and target heart rate to judge moderate versus vigorous exercise intensity as a beginner.

item.title: Rest Days for Beginners, What the Activity Guidelines Actually Say
item.description: What CDC and federal physical activity guidelines specifically say about muscle-strengthening frequency and recovery between sessions for beginners.
